findings.suggestion: One shared engine list (for example NG.EVENT_GOALS) that all event plugins read.
findings.what: Every new island event needs its goal added by hand to each other event plugin's own KEEP list. This session patched five plugins (flight, hiccups, sneeze, freeze, conga) after a real interruption, and the next event will hit the same trap.

summary: The Island Choir is a charming new event and its hint, message and panel text show correctly in the running sandbox (frame median 3.8 ms). But the engine source no longer precompiles: dev/NeverendingGame/src/web.jl was edited at 19:27:36 and uses `js"""` with only `import Bonito`, so the next game or sandbox restart will crash-loop. The film with the song is still unrendered.
surprise_why: A conducted island choir with a sung chord and a planned BWAARP is a nice twist, but it is another party event in the same pattern, and nobody can hear it in the game yet.
